author: Danny Garrison
title: 2026 Post-Draft Power Rankings
body:
Welcome back, league.

A lot has changed since the very first draft 10 years ago. We've had weddings, births, moves, Amazon defections, and many other major life changes as time has marched on. But it's nice to know some things stay the same, like the little circular arrows over Craig's profile picture that indicate he's on autodraft or the first Brown coming off the board way too early.

As always, Yahoo's draft grades are offensively bad. AI can build us a stunning website, but you know what it can't do? Know ball.

That's what you have me for.

## 1. Whit | 2025: 10-4, runner-up
The two trendiest WRs of the offseason paired with three potential RB1s. But unfortunately any roster with BTJ on it is cursed.
[roster]
QB: Trevor Lawrence
RB: Jahmyr Gibbs, Kyren Williams, Ashton Jeanty, Jordan Mason
WR: Emeka Egbuka, Luther Burden III, Brian Thomas Jr., Michael Wilson
TE: Travis Kelce, Isaiah Likely
[/roster]

## 2. Beau | 2025: 9-5, made playoffs
The deadliest stack in modern fantasy history. And it's an even year, so the Bengals might even be relevant past November.
[roster]
QB: Joe Burrow
RB: Javonte Williams, Quinshon Judkins, Aaron Jones Sr., Tyler Allgeier
WR: Ja'Marr Chase, Drake London, DK Metcalf, Jordan Addison, Xavier Worthy
TE: Tyler Warren
[/roster]

## 3. Danny | 2025: 7-7, missed playoffs
With Mike McDaniel on the sticks, Justin Herbert could become Tom Brady on even more steroids. If Mike chooses to funnel targets to Ladd and doesn't do something stupid like run the ball, this stack could go ballistic.
[roster]
QB: Justin Herbert
RB: Kenneth Walker III, Travis Etienne Jr., Kenny Gainwell, Emmett Johnson
WR: Puka Nacua, Ladd McConkey, Jameson Williams, Parker Washington, KC Concepcion
TE: Kyle Pitts Sr.
[/roster]

## 4. Steve | 2025: 5-9, missed playoffs
High floors, high ceilings, and depth. And De'Von Achane might touch the ball 50 times per game since the Dolphins' other starters are plumbers and insurance salesmen.
[roster]
QB: Drake Maye
RB: De'Von Achane, Bhayshul Tuten, Rico Dowdle, RJ Harvey, Kyle Monangai
WR: CeeDee Lamb, Jaylen Waddle, Quentin Johnston, Wan'Dale Robinson
TE: Colston Loveland
[/roster]

## 5. Ryan | 2025: 2-12, last place
I would normally advise against a QB/RB/TE pairing from the same team but Ryan might have every Eagles TD for the entire season on his roster.
[roster]
QB: Jalen Hurts
RB: Saquon Barkley, Breece Hall, David Montgomery
WR: A.J. Brown, Tee Higgins, Stefon Diggs, Michael Pittman Jr., Jakobi Meyers
TE: Sam LaPorta, Dallas Goedert
[/roster]

## 6. Craig | 2025: 6-8, missed playoffs
Autodraft might have cooked here. I don't know if I've ever seen that many questionable tags in a Week 1 lineup but the upside is big.
[roster]
QB: Lamar Jackson, Dak Prescott
RB: Christian McCaffrey, Jonathon Brooks, Rachaad White
WR: Nico Collins, Malik Nabers, Tetairoa McMillan, Chris Godwin Jr., Romeo Doubs
TE: Tucker Kraft
[/roster]

## 7. Andrew | 2025: 9-5, champion
There's a lot of depth on this roster but injuries could quickly derail Andrew's quest for a repeat.
[roster]
QB: Jayden Daniels
RB: Omarion Hampton, Jeremiyah Love, D'Andre Swift, Jadarian Price
WR: Amon-Ra St. Brown, Christian Watson, Josh Downs, Makai Lemon, Jalen Coker
TE: Mark Andrews
[/roster]

## 8. Dave | 2025: 9-5, made playoffs
Eventually someone will get caught holding the bag when Derrick Henry falls off, but I don't think this is the year.
[roster]
QB: Caleb Williams
RB: Derrick Henry, Rhamondre Stevenson, Jaylen Warren, Chris Rodriguez Jr., Zach Charbonnet
WR: Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Rashee Rice, De'Zhaun Stribling, Matthew Golden
TE: Trey McBride
[/roster]

## 9. Nick | 2025: 8-6, made playoffs
Two of Nick's top four picks are at risk of having a mental health crisis that keeps them off the field but he also has Josh Allen so he has hope.
[roster]
QB: Josh Allen
RB: Jonathan Taylor, Cam Skattebo, Tony Pollard, Jacory Croskey-Merritt
WR: George Pickens, Terry McLaurin, Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel Sr., Jordyn Tyson
TE: George Kittle
[/roster]

## 10. Evan | 2025: 5-9, missed playoffs
It turns out there is one Kyler Murray believer left.
[roster]
QB: Kyler Murray
RB: Bijan Robinson, J.K. Dobbins, MarShawn Lloyd
WR: Garrett Wilson, Chris Olave, Rome Odunze, DJ Moore, Jayden Reed, Mike Washington Jr.
TE: Dalton Kincaid
[/roster]

## 11. Corey | 2025: 8-6, made playoffs
An aggressive draft reach just to keep your team name pun is a move I can respect, but not one that I can rank highly.
[roster]
QB: Jaxson Dart
RB: James Cook III, TreVeyon Henderson, Chuba Hubbard, Josh Jacobs
WR: DeVonta Smith, Davante Adams, Marvin Harrison Jr., Alec Pierce, Khalil Shakir
TE: Brock Bowers
[/roster]

## 12. Mike | 2025: 6-8, missed playoffs
I wonder which continent Mike will draft a perfectly mid team from next year.
[roster]
QB: Matthew Stafford
RB: Chase Brown, Bucky Irving, Blake Corum, Woody Marks
WR: Justin Jefferson, Zay Flowers, Carnell Tate, Courtland Sutton
TE: Harold Fannin Jr., Brenton Strange
[/roster]
